name: Attendance 2
definition: Information and conditions provided for the physical attendance to the meeting.

AdmissionConditions.name: Admission Conditions
AdmissionConditions.definition: Conditions for physical admittance to the general meeting.

ConfirmationInformation.name: Confirmation Information
ConfirmationInformation.definition: Specifies how to order the attendance card or to give notice of attendance.

ConfirmationDeadline.name: Confirmation Deadline
ConfirmationDeadline.definition: Date and time by which the beneficial owner or agent must provide notification of its intention to participate in the meeting. This deadline is set by an intermediary.

ConfirmationMarketDeadline.name: Confirmation Market Deadline
ConfirmationMarketDeadline.definition: Date and time by which the attendance to the meeting should be confirmed. This deadline is set by the issuer.
